body.name: least-favorable collection experiment handle
body.construction: Begin at \(P_n^{\mathrm{split}}\). For a local displacement \(h\), tilt the Rademacher probability of the complier receipt-zero outcome by an amount proportional to \(h\), and counter-tilt the never-taker receipt-zero probability by \(\mu_nh/(1-\mu_n)\), preserving the control-arm mixture. For a general support face, apply these compensated tilts cellwise with signed amplitudes selected from the dual of \(\mathcal A_{\mathrm{coll}}(p_T,\mathcal H)\); this is the route to the quadratic observed-law experiment \(\mathcal G_{\mathrm{coll}}(P)\).
